title.narrative: A.1.1. Conduct Inception workshops for targeted CSOs and local authorities. (One workshop per governorate)

description.narrative: The purpose of the inception workshop is to have a common understanding on ways of working, implementation modality for the Human rights and women’s rights for components among targeted CSOs and local stakeholders in the targeted governorates. The one-day workshop would provide the basis and smooth coordination between targeted CSOs and local authorities to facilitate activities in the target areas. In the workshop, effort would be made to ensure providing an overview on “Governance of CSOs Working on Human Rights including Women’s Rights” project as well as a discussion would be made to build consensus common approach, work plan, M&E templates, communication and visibility plan. Resonate! Yemen will ensure high level of participation and engagement among project targeted CSOs and local authorities by implementing the inception workshop.

activity-date.narrative: Reporting on the inception workshops were completed by the end of October.
The preparation was initiated at the beginning of October, with the first workshop conducted on October 16 in Marib and the second workshop on October 18 in Shabwa.

recipient-country.narrative: Yemen is currently one of the world’s largest humanitarian crises, with over 21 million people in need of assistance1. The ongoing conflict has severely impacted the country’s infrastructure, including food, water, and healthcare systems.The situation is further complicated by restrictions on humanitarian access and internal displacement, affecting millions of Yemenis. Despite significant international aid, the needs remain immense.

sector.narrative: The main objective of these workshops was to establish a common understanding of the working methods and the implementation of human rights and women's rights components between the targeted civil society organizations and local stakeholders in the respective governorates.

title.narrative: # inception workshops conducted with all targeted and expected CSOs in Shabwa and Marib to gain a broader picture of the current and developing context of human and women rights and civil society in general.

description.narrative: Two inception workshops took place in two governorates: Marib on October 16 and Shabwa on October 18. These inception workshops lasted for a day and were well-attended, with a total of 41 participants. The participants included 17 members from various civil society organizations that were selected as targeted CSOs based on the mapping conducted in Activity Output 1.2.2., and 7 representatives from the local community, as well as 17 representatives of local authorities. The representatives encompassed a diverse range of individuals, including women, youth, and local authorities. Notably, the workshops achieved a balanced gender representation, as 34% of the participants were females.
